import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

def get_features(db, entity_ids, seed_time):
    if isinstance(entity_ids, (list, np.ndarray, pd.Series)):
        product_ids = list(entity_ids)
    else:
        product_ids = [entity_ids]

    orders = db["orders"]
    items = db["order_items"]
    reviews = db["reviews"]
    payments = db["payments"]

    # --- Позиции: только покупки, совершённые до seed_time ---
    items_filtered = items[items["product_id"].isin(product_ids)].copy()
    items_filtered = items_filtered[items_filtered["ts"] < seed_time]

    # --- Заказы: берём только те, что были созданы до seed_time ---
    orders_hist = orders[orders["order_purchase_timestamp"] < seed_time].copy()

    # Статус/даты доставки валидны только если событие уже произошло до seed_time
    delivered_mask = (
        orders_hist["order_delivered_customer_date"].notna()
        & (orders_hist["order_delivered_customer_date"] < seed_time)
    )
    orders_hist["delivered_before_seed"] = delivered_mask.astype(int)
    orders_hist.loc[~delivered_mask, "order_delivered_customer_date"] = pd.NaT

    # Признак: заказ ещё не доставлен на момент seed_time
    orders_hist["not_delivered_yet"] = (
        (orders_hist["order_delivered_carrier_date"].isna())
        | (orders_hist["order_delivered_carrier_date"] >= seed_time)
    ).astype(int)

    merged = items_filtered.merge(
        orders_hist[["order_id", "order_status", "order_delivered_customer_date",
                     "delivered_before_seed", "not_delivered_yet"]],
        on="order_id", how="left"
    )

    # --- Платежи: только те, что известны до seed_time (ts покупки) ---
    pay_hist = payments[payments["ts"] < seed_time]
    pay_agg = pay_hist.groupby("order_id").agg(
        total_payment=("payment_value", "sum"),
        count_payments=("payment_value", "count"),
        avg_installments=("payment_installments", "mean")
    ).reset_index()

    # --- Отзывы: только те, что уже созданы до seed_time ---
    rev_hist = reviews[reviews["review_creation_date"] < seed_time].copy()
    rev_hist["positive"] = (rev_hist["review_score"] >= 4).astype(int)
    rev_agg = rev_hist.groupby("order_id").agg(
        avg_review=("review_score", "mean"),
        count_reviews=("review_score", "count"),
        positive_count=("positive", "sum")
    ).reset_index()
    rev_agg["positive_ratio"] = rev_agg["positive_count"] / rev_agg["count_reviews"]

    merged = merged.merge(pay_agg, on="order_id", how="left")
    merged = merged.merge(rev_agg, on="order_id", how="left")

    # Время доставки считается только для доставленных до seed_time заказов
    merged["delivery_days"] = (
        (merged["order_delivered_customer_date"] - merged["ts"]).dt.days
    )

    # ============================================================
    # Агрегаты по позициям
    # ============================================================
    pos_agg = merged.groupby("product_id").agg(
        total_items=("price", "count"),
        total_price=("price", "sum"),
        total_freight=("freight_value", "sum"),
        avg_price=("price", "mean"),
        std_price=("price", "std"),
        min_price=("price", "min"),
        max_price=("price", "max"),
        avg_freight=("freight_value", "mean"),
        std_freight=("freight_value", "std"),
        avg_delivery_days=("delivery_days", "mean"),
        delivered_ratio=("delivered_before_seed", "mean"),
        not_delivered_ratio=("not_delivered_yet", "mean")
    ).reset_index()

    # ============================================================
    # Агрегаты по уникальным заказам
    # ============================================================
    order_level = merged[["product_id", "order_id", "ts",
                          "total_payment", "count_payments", "avg_installments",
                          "avg_review", "count_reviews", "positive_ratio"]].drop_duplicates(
                              subset=["product_id", "order_id"])

    order_agg = order_level.groupby("product_id").agg(
        num_orders=("order_id", "nunique"),
        total_payment_all=("total_payment", "sum"),
        avg_payment_per_order=("total_payment", "mean"),
        std_payment_per_order=("total_payment", "std"),
        avg_payments_per_order=("count_payments", "mean"),
        avg_install_mean=("avg_installments", "mean"),
        avg_review_score=("avg_review", "mean"),
        avg_review_count=("count_reviews", "mean"),
        avg_positive_ratio=("positive_ratio", "mean")
    ).reset_index()

    temp_agg = order_level.groupby("product_id").agg(
        days_since_last=("ts", lambda x: (seed_time - x.max()).days),
        days_since_first=("ts", lambda x: (seed_time - x.min()).days),
        date_span=("ts", lambda x: (x.max() - x.min()).days)
    ).reset_index()

    # Тренд: продажи в последние 30/90 дней против более раннего периода
    order_level["recency_30"] = (order_level["ts"] >= seed_time - pd.Timedelta(days=30)).astype(int)
    order_level["recency_90"] = (order_level["ts"] >= seed_time - pd.Timedelta(days=90)).astype(int)
    rec_agg = order_level.groupby("product_id").agg(
        orders_last_30=("recency_30", "sum"),
        orders_last_90=("recency_90", "sum")
    ).reset_index()

    features = pos_agg.merge(order_agg, on="product_id", how="outer")
    features = features.merge(temp_agg, on="product_id", how="outer")
    features = features.merge(rec_agg, on="product_id", how="outer")
    features = features.set_index("product_id")

    result = pd.DataFrame(index=product_ids)
    result = result.join(features, how="left")

    result["has_sales"] = result["num_orders"].notna().astype(int)
    result = result.fillna(0)
    result = result.astype(float)
    result = result.loc[product_ids]
    return result
